errors.current: Careful: جَمَل (camel) and جَمِيل (beautiful) come from different roots.
errors.problem: Wrong fact about Arabic morphology: جَمَل and جَمِيل have the same root letters ج-م-ل (both are listed under جمل in every dictionary). The note teaches a beginner a false root analysis, and the course teaches roots explicitly elsewhere (k-t-b, ʿ-l-m, j-m-ʿ).
errors.fix: Careful: جَمَل (camel) and جَمِيل (beautiful) share the root letters j-m-l but are different words: don't mix them up.
errors.alsoChange: none (tap glosses for جَمَل and جَمِيل stay)

notes.note: The note still teaches يَنْزِلُ الثَّلْج as THE way to say 'it's snowing', while decision R12-18 changed the grammar card to يَتَسَاقَطُ الثَّلْجُ. Both are correct Arabic; consider 'say يَنْزِلُ الثَّلْج or يَتَسَاقَطُ الثَّلْجُ (snow falls)' for consistency.
The headword is vocalised جَذْر (jadhr) while the id is jidhr; both are attested, but جِذْر is the more usual vocalisation in MSA dictionaries (Wehr: jidr). Not an error.

الْيَوْمُ الْخَامِسُ مِنْ نُوفَمْبِر (decided in round 1) can still be read as the phrase 'the fifth day of November'; الْيَوْمُ هُوَ الْخَامِسُ would make the sentence unambiguous for a beginner. Kept as decided.
هٰذَا الْهَرَم كَبِير وَقَدِيم جِدًّا is translated 'very big and very old'; the Arabic has one جِدًّا at the end. 'big and very old' is closer (English only).
The transliterated note reads 'ash-shams is said ash-shams' because the Arabic الشَّمْس is romanised next to the hand-written romanisation. Cosmetic, only if the ⟶ line of notes is shown to learners.

الْيَوْم نُتَرْجِمُ مَشْرُوعًا كَبِيرًا ('we are translating a big project') is correct but odd; 'we are working on a big translation project' (نَعْمَلُ عَلَى مَشْرُوعِ تَرْجَمَةٍ كَبِير) would be more natural.
الْجِبَال is translated 'hills' (Amman's jabals); fine in context, but the tap says 'the mountains'.

summary: Reviewed audit/vocabulary.txt lines 9015-17988 (vocabulary.json entries [411] raha to [808] yastamirru, 398 words): about 1,700 Arabic strings (headwords, plurals, forms, examples, Arabic in notes) and about 6,000 tap glosses, plus every note and English translation. Found 5 errors: 1 major grammar-fact (the jamal note says جَمَل and جَمِيل come from different roots; they share j-m-l), 3 minor gloss errors (يَنْزِلُ glossed 'gets off, gets out' in the snow sentences, الْأُوبِرَا glossed as a metro station in 'the Opera House', يَسْتَعْمِلُ glossed '(it) uses'), and 1 minor engine issue (missing clitic hyphen in bijāʾizati where the gloss is '(with) the prize'). The vocalisation, case endings (kāna/laysa/inna/anna, numbers 3-10 and 11-99 with their counted nouns, ordinals in dates and centuries, subjunctive after an/lan, jussive after lam/lā), agreement (plurals of things with feminine singular) and verb forms in this half are otherwise correct; earlier rounds have clearly cleaned it. 0 Arabic-string errors found; the remaining issues are glosses and one note.
